text:
tess: FYI observed recurring OOMs in shard pool last night, seems correlated with long-running chat sessions. Heap climbs slowly then spikes.
rahul: Saw the same on staging, profiling shows ~30% of retained memory is from KV entry tombstones that never get freed. :thinking_face:
jun: Uploading traces and allocation flamegraphs to the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/phantom-reserve/trace-2026-03-20
leo: Quick question: are these entries due to a GC miss or reference being held by a scorer thread?
rahul: The flamegraph points at scorer->cache_lookup path holding a shared_ptr for ~2min. Suspect path that caches user embeddings without TTL.
tess: Action list (short):
  1) rahul -> add TTL + weak ref path to scorer by EOD Fri (2026-03-26)
  2) jun -> add a targeted heap snapshot job that triggers after 60s of sustained growth, due Mon (2026-03-29)
  3) leo -> run a GC stress job with altered fragmentation thresholds and report perf delta, due Tue (2026-03-30)
  4) infra -> add eviction metric alarms to avoid full OOM, tentative owner = sre-bot, due Wed (2026-03-31)
rahul: I'll push a patch that annotates the KV put path with `maybe_weak=true` flag and a small TTL. Test plan: unit + staging soak 12h.
jun: Snapshot harness command for local repro: ```
./tools/heap_snapshot --target scorer --duration 900 --out /tmp/heap-phantom.json
```
leo: For GC stress, I'll run three runs with thresholds 0.6/0.7/0.8 and compare compaction times + tail latency. Will post CSV.
sre-bot: alert created: KV_cache_eviction_high (threshold: 85%); escalation: eng-runtime oncall
tess: Notes from profiling: fragmentation increases after repeated small inserts when cache churn is high. Possible allocator tuning + run compaction during low traffic windows.
rahul: If TTL is acceptable, we should be able to cut retained mem by ~20% per profile preliminary numbers. I'll attach diffs in the PR.
jun: Also adding an integration test that simulates long chat session plus random evictions; if we can reproduce in CI that's ideal.
leo: Reminder: keep an eye on tail latency; aggressive eviction helped memory but increased p99 by ~40ms in earlier experiments.
tess: Meeting to sync owners tomorrow at 10am PST — invite sent. Please update the runbook with links to PRs and perf CSVs.
rahul: PR link (draft): https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/3214 (will mark ready once tests pass)
jun: I'll attach the first heap snapshot result here after the night soak.
leo: I'll also try a different slab size for allocator and post results.
tess: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for follow-ups. If anything slips, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
